lines.text: You wake on cold linoleum. Redacted files tower above you. Your head is empty of why you're here.
Look around. Click objects in the room to examine or take them. Press I to open your inventory.
Maybe you should look around. Things here might respond if you click them.
Researcher ID. The photo might be you—the name field is smudged.
Level-2 keycard. Still warm, like someone left in a hurry.
The drawer is empty.
Nothing left in the locker.
Security door. You'll need your keycard.
The badge reader demands a registered name before it will clear you. Register yourself first.
The reader chirps. The door unlatches into the east corridor.
Rows of redacted binders. Someone circled a date—yesterday.
Papers coat the floor like snow. Somewhere close, something moves.
Cafeteria memo: all break-room microwaves replaced. Mundane. Almost reassuring.
You've already read this memo.
Incident follow-up—Subject interaction logged. Appendix pages torn out.
The next line is still loading when something cold finds the nape of your neck.
Scorch marks on the floor. Whatever was here left in a hurry.
Personnel roster. Every name blacked out except one—unreadable, but familiar.
Only ash remains.
The archives feel safer than the corridor.
A shape at the edge of vision. It studies you—measuring friend or threat.

choices.text: Offer the notes you picked up from other papers.

lines.text: It stills. For now, you think it understands.
It bristles. You'll hear from it again—and not kindly.
